SELECT
  first_trans.fullVisitorId AS fullVisitorId,
  DATE_DIFF(first_trans.first_transaction_date, first_visit.first_visit_date, DAY) AS days_between_first_visit_and_first_transaction,
  first_trans.device_category AS transaction_device_category
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)) AS first_visit_date
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    GROUP BY
      fullVisitorId
  ) AS first_visit
JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)) AS first_transaction_date,
      ARRAY_AGG(device.deviceCategory ORDER BY PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS device_category
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
      UNNEST(hits) AS h
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
      AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      fullVisitorId
  ) AS first_trans
ON
  first_visit.fullVisitorId = first_trans.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY
  days_between_first_visit_and_first_transaction ASC,
  fullVisitorId

WITH inpatient_2014_rows AS (
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  provider_city AS city,
  total_discharges,
  average_total_payments AS total_payments
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
),
drg_total_discharges AS (
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS sum_discharges_drg
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
GROUP BY
  drg_definition
)
SELECT
  i.drg_definition,
  i.city,
  SUM(i.total_discharges) AS total_discharges_city,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(i.total_payments * i.total_discharges), SUM(i.total_discharges)) AS weighted_avg_total_payments
FROM inpatient_2014_rows i
JOIN (
  SELECT drg_definition
  FROM drg_total_discharges
  ORDER BY sum_discharges_drg DESC
  LIMIT 1
) top_drg
ON i.drg_definition = top_drg.drg_definition
GROUP BY i.drg_definition, i.city
ORDER BY total_discharges_city DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH provider_combined_average AS (
SELECT
  COALESCE(o.provider_id, i.provider_id) AS provider_id,
  COALESCE(o.provider_name, i.provider_name) AS provider_name,
  -- outpatient average cost comes from outpatient_charges_* average_estimated_submitted_charges
  o.outpatient_avg_cost,
  -- inpatient average cost comes from inpatient_charges_* average_medicare_payments
  i.inpatient_avg_cost,
  -- combined is sum of the two averages; lift any literal (none) out of view
  SAFE_ADD(o.outpatient_avg_cost, i.inpatient_avg_cost) AS combined_average
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      provider_id,
      ANY_VALUE(provider_name) AS provider_name,
      AVG(average_estimated_submitted_charges) AS outpatient_avg_cost
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    GROUP BY provider_id
  ) o
FULL JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      provider_id,
      ANY_VALUE(provider_name) AS provider_name,
      AVG(average_medicare_payments) AS inpatient_avg_cost
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    GROUP BY provider_id
  ) i
USING (provider_id)
),
provider_cost_records_2014 AS (
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  'inpatient' AS cost_type,
  average_medicare_payments AS avg_cost
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  'outpatient' AS cost_type,
  average_total_payments AS avg_cost
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
)
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  outpatient_avg_cost,
  inpatient_avg_cost,
  combined_average
FROM
  provider_combined_average
WHERE
  outpatient_avg_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND inpatient_avg_cost IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  combined_average DESC
LIMIT 1

  nppes_provider_state AS state,

SELECT
  year,
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  ROUND(inpatient_cost_avg,2) AS yearly_avg_inpatient_cost,
  ROUND(outpatient_cost_avg,2) AS yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
FROM (
  -- Identify provider with highest total inpatient Medicare cost across 2011-2015
  WITH provider_totals AS (
    SELECT
      provider_id,
      ANY_VALUE(provider_name) AS provider_name,
      SUM(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS total_inpatient_cost_2011_2015
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    GROUP BY provider_id
  ),
  top_provider AS (
    SELECT provider_id, provider_name
    FROM provider_totals
    ORDER BY total_inpatient_cost_2011_2015 DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  -- Compute yearly inpatient averages for that provider
  inpatient_by_year AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) AS year,
      provider_id,
      ANY_VALUE(provider_name) AS provider_name,
      AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS inpatient_cost_avg
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
      AND provider_id IN (SELECT provider_id FROM top_provider)
    GROUP BY year, provider_id
  ),
  -- Compute yearly outpatient averages for that provider
  outpatient_by_year AS (
    SELECT
      CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) AS year,
      provider_id,
      ANY_VALUE(provider_name) AS provider_name,
      AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services) AS outpatient_cost_avg
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
      AND provider_id IN (SELECT provider_id FROM top_provider)
    GROUP BY year, provider_id
  )
  -- Combine inpatient and outpatient yearly results; ensure all years 2011-2015 appear
  SELECT
    y.year,
    tp.provider_id,
    tp.provider_name,
    COALESCE(i.inpatient_cost_avg, 0) AS inpatient_cost_avg,
    COALESCE(o.outpatient_cost_avg, 0) AS outpatient_cost_avg
  FROM
    (SELECT 2011 AS year UNION ALL SELECT 2012 UNION ALL SELECT 2013 UNION ALL SELECT 2014 UNION ALL SELECT 2015) AS y
    CROSS JOIN top_provider tp
    LEFT JOIN inpatient_by_year i
      ON i.year = y.year AND i.provider_id = tp.provider_id
    LEFT JOIN outpatient_by_year o
      ON o.year = y.year AND o.provider_id = tp.provider_id
  ORDER BY y.year
)

WITH
-- base standard ICD-10-CM concept ids for the four chapters (L70, L20, L40, L80) using concept_code prefix match
icd10_roots AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_code, concept_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept`
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'ICD10CM'
    AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(concept_code, r'^(L20|L40|L70|L80)(\..*)?$')
    AND standard_concept = 'S'
),

-- find all descendant concepts (including the root itself) via concept_ancestor table
icd10_all_concepts AS (
  SELECT a.ancestor_concept_id AS root_concept_id,
         d.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM icd10_roots a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` d
    ON d.ancestor_concept_id = a.concept_id
  UNION DISTINCT
  -- include the root concepts themselves in case they are not listed as their own ancestor
  SELECT concept_id AS root_concept_id, concept_id
  FROM icd10_roots
),

-- map root labels (L20/L40/L70/L80) to each root_concept_id
roots_labeled AS (
  SELECT concept_id AS root_concept_id,
         CASE
           WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(concept_code, r'^L20') THEN 'Atopic dermatitis (L20)'
           WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(concept_code, r'^L40') THEN 'Psoriasis (L40)'
           WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(concept_code, r'^L70') THEN 'Acne (L70)'
           WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(concept_code, r'^L80') THEN 'Vitiligo (L80)'
           ELSE 'Other'
         END AS label
  FROM icd10_roots
),

-- join concepts to their labels
concepts_labeled AS (
  SELECT c.root_concept_id, r.label, c.concept_id
  FROM icd10_all_concepts c
  JOIN roots_labeled r USING (root_concept_id)
),

-- filter condition occurrences to only those that use standard concepts (condition_concept_id is standard)
-- and that match any of the ICD-10 descendant concepts
condition_flags AS (
  SELECT
    p.person_id,
    cl.label
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` p
    USING (person_id)
  JOIN concepts_labeled cl
    ON co.condition_concept_id = cl.concept_id
  -- ensure the condition concept is a standard concept in the concept table
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` c
    ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
  WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S'
),

-- for each person and label, keep distinct presence (a person counts once per condition group)
person_label_distinct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id, label
  FROM condition_flags
),

-- count persons per label
counts_per_label AS (
  SELECT label, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons_with_condition
  FROM person_label_distinct
  GROUP BY label
),

-- total distinct participants in person table
total_persons AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS total_persons
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
)

SELECT
  cpl.label AS condition_group,
  cpl.persons_with_condition,
  tp.total_persons,
  ROUND(100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(cpl.persons_with_condition, tp.total_persons), 4) AS percent_of_participants
FROM counts_per_label cpl
CROSS JOIN total_persons tp
ORDER BY cpl.label

-- percentage of participants NOT using quinapril (RxCUI 35208) or its descendant drug concepts,
-- using a cost-guard friendly approach: first identify relevant drug_concept_ids from concept_ancestor
-- and then restrict scans by joining only needed tables and using EXISTS/NOT EXISTS.
WITH quinapril_concepts AS (
  -- get quinapril and its descendants (including itself)
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 35208
),
users_of_quinapril AS (
  -- persons who have at least one drug_exposure to those concepts
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  JOIN quinapril_concepts qc
    ON de.drug_concept_id = qc.concept_id
),
population AS (
  -- all persons (use person table primary key)
  SELECT person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
)
SELECT
  -- counts and percentage not using quinapril
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM population) AS total_persons,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM population p
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM users_of_quinapril u WHERE u.person_id = p.person_id
   )
  ) AS persons_not_using_quinapril,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM population p
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM users_of_quinapril u WHERE u.person_id = p.person_id
     )
    ),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM population)
  ) * 100.0 AS percent_not_using_quinapril
